title: YOUR model is BROKEN it's coding worse, it's planning worse it's burning my time.
body:
This is no beyond a joke a plan i do every day to work gets done ones from the template i have and is no problem for a WEEK now every day it can't follow the clear instructions that have worked ALL YEAR and now it has to redo the plan 5-10 times it's horrible what you have done to this AI model now it does not work anywhere near what it used to it's so dumb, making a lot of mistakes over and over again. This type of stuff means it's used more as its spent fixing over and over things it's broken that it should not have touched. 

I have very very clearly documentation on what it can and cannot do, but now it won't work in a week since your updated. before it was perfect.

top_comments.body: @fwends I have tried downgrading to 1.0.24. This is like a very early version from a month ago. No planning mode, no sub-agents, etc... From what I'm seeing, it works better, so maybe it's not the model, it's the agent. Today I'm testing release 1.0.55. I believe that's the one before things started going bad.

top_comments.body:
@heyagent Pleasee let us know what you find. I am also very frustrated because I cannot trust claude code like before anymore. Everything needs to be watched so closely and micro managed....
Would be great to at least have the planning mode and claude code working propperly again. I did notice a sharper drop off in skills and mistakes in the timeframe of about 10 - 14 days
